The post Hero Support Dog Saves Husband’s Life After Alerting Deaf Owner to His Deadly Midnight Fall Down Stairs appeared first on Good News Network.

Actual Article Body:
A deaf woman says her support dog saved her husband’s life after he fell down the stairs—by waking her from a dead sleep to insist something was wrong.

Sandra Donally was alerted by her clever pup after husband Gary tumbled down the stairs in the middle of the night and was left bleeding and unconscious.

She had been fast asleep when Storm suddenly leapt onto her bed shortly after midnight, startling her awake.

Sandra noticed the landing light was on and guessed that Gary had simply gone to the bathroom, but the dog’s strange behavior set alarm bells ringing.

“She just sat ramrod straight at the other end of the bed, staring out towards the landing,” said the 62-year-old from Staffordshire, England.

“I told her that Gary was in the bathroom and asked her to go back to bed, but she wouldn’t move.”

Moments later, she found Gary lying crumpled at the bottom of the staircase.

Paramedics rushed him to Royal Stoke Hospital, where he remained for 24 days undergoing reconstructive surgery on his broken jaw.

The couple later worked out that Gary had come out of the bathroom, lost his footing and fell down the stairs after missing the handrail.

Sandra said she couldn’t bear to imagine what would have happened if Storm had not alerted her—believing the pooch saved his life.

“When she wouldn’t look at me, I knew something was wrong.

“We usually get up at half past six, so that’s when I would’ve noticed Gary wasn’t in bed—he’d have lain there for six hours, losing blood and with a broken jaw.

“I’ll always be so grateful to her for alerting me.”

Sandra lost her hearing very suddenly in 2017 due to a rare disorder, and was partnered with the trained service dog named Storm in 2024.

“I don’t feel withdrawn anymore because I have Storm by my side; I’m out and about and it’s great.”
